title: 第299章 田曼琪，被你害惨了！
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“以下洼村外面的大河为界，大河外侧你们可以自由寻庇护所，大河里侧是我们的，不容许踏足！五把铁锹给你们，自己去挖庇护所吧。”

周凛说完这番话，铁锹刚好到了，咣当一声扔在田曼琪面前。

田曼琪抬起头，“真的没有商量的余地了吗？你真的忍心看我们在外面受苦等死？”

周凛懒得搭理她，往后退了几步，“把人赶走。”

士兵们上前，连推带拉，将人一步步往山下带。

“我不走！放开我！我要住进山洞！”

田曼琪大声嘶吼，死活要赖在这。

周凛的枪法很准，他浪费了一颗子弹，砰的一声，打在田曼琪脚边。

田曼琪吓得紧缩回脚，不敢再出声。

“那条大河是最后的界限，只要你们再敢踏入半步，不要怪我不客气！”

周凛这话一出，众人都闭了嘴。

他们默默站起身，不需要士兵再往外推，缓缓往外退。

田曼琪拍拍身上的土，满脸恨意：

“周凛！你不要后悔！”

她气冲冲地转身，带着人离去。

距离山洞越来越远，下洼村庇护所那头的声音已经听不见了。

人群里，只剩下田曼琪等人粗重的喘息声。

“田总管，现在怎么办？”

有人问。

“怎么办！怎么办！天天就知道问，我上哪知道怎么办？”

田曼琪正在气头上，说话语气不善。

“你不知道，指望我们知道吗？当初是你撺掇我们出来的！”

问问题的是个黑瘦的中年人，下巴翘着，鞋耙子脸。

他破罐子破摔，第一次正面反驳了田曼琪。

要说回庇护所之前，田曼琪说什么都可以，只要她能领着他们活下去就行。

可今天回了庇护所，鞋耙子脸才真正醒悟，这田曼琪只有嘴上功夫，说什么庇护所需要人力一定会收留他们。

可庇护所过的正滋润，他们回去只会分粮食，分水，跟山洞，人家巴不得别人躲得远远的。

而田曼琪的那些言论，都是春秋大梦！

此刻的田曼琪，一脸不可置信的盯着鞋耙子脸。

“什么意思？你现在是在怪我吗？当初可是你自己自愿跟着我走的！要怪就怪你自己活该！”

"The river outside the village is bounded by the river. You are free to find shelter outside the river. The inside of the river is ours and you are not allowed to set foot on it! I'll give you five shovels. Go dig a shelter yourself."

After Zhou Lin said these words, the shovel arrived just in time and was thrown in front of Tian Manqi with a clang.

Tian Manqi raised her head, "Is there really no room for negotiation? Do you really have the heart to see us suffer outside and wait to die?"

Zhou Lin was too lazy to pay attention to her, and took a few steps back, "Kick people away."

The soldiers stepped forward, pushing and pulling, and led the people down the mountain step by step.

"I won't leave! Let me go! I want to live in a cave!"

Tian Manqi screamed loudly, her life and death depended on this.

Zhou Lin's shooting skills were very accurate. He wasted a bullet and hit Tian Manqi's feet with a bang.

Tian Manqi was so frightened that she shrank back and didn't dare to say anything again.

"That big river is the final limit. As long as you dare to step even half a step further, don't blame me for being rude!"

As soon as Zhou Lin said these words, everyone shut up.

They stood up silently, without the need for soldiers to push further, and slowly retreated.

Tian Manqi patted the dirt on her body, her face filled with hatred:

"Zhou Lin! Don't regret it!"

She turned around angrily and left with the people.

Getting further and further away from the cave, the sounds from the shelter in Xiawa Village can no longer be heard.

In the crowd, the only sounds left were the heavy breathing of Tian Manqi and others.

"Mr. Tian, what should we do now?"

someone asked.

"What to do! What to do! I ask every day, where do I know what to do?"

Tian Manqi was angry and spoke in a bad tone.

"You don't know, do you expect us to know? You were the one who instigated us to come out in the first place!"

The person who asked the question was a dark, thin, middle-aged man with a tilted chin and a rake face.

He broke the pot and refuted Tian Manqi head-on for the first time.

Before returning to the shelter, Tian Manqi can say anything, as long as she can lead them to survive.

But after returning to the shelter today, Shoe Raekian finally realized that Tian Manqi could only pay lip service, saying that the shelter would take them in if it needed manpower.

But the shelter is enjoying a good life. When they go back, they will only share food, water, and caves. They wish others could hide far away.

And those remarks made by Tian Manqi are all spring and autumn dreams!

At this moment, Tian Manqi stared at the shoe rake's face in disbelief.

"What do you mean? Are you blaming me now? You followed me voluntarily at the beginning! If you want to blame, you deserve it!"
